Full red-team primer and all four fixed seats addressed the release seat's proposal for universal manual checkpoint review and cleanup. Each supports conditional cleanup, with explicit intervention for retained states. Seat agreement unanimous on the exercised outcome. The three original blocking findings were repaired and independently cleared.
